title: Power Cube
keywords: Small FE buffer with a Discharge input and Charge output

blocks.text: Small FE buffer with a Discharge input and Charge output. Its charge rate is deliberately separate from its cable transfer rate.

rows: Feed FE from a permitted input face or discharge a supported battery/consumable.
Put a powered item in Charge to transfer energy out of the cube.
Connect output faces to machines and verify both side and adapter policies.

blocks.text: A slowly charging item may be limited by the configured item charge rate, not by the cube capacity. Empty FE or a full receiver also pauses charging.
